```{r}
# Quadratic Model 
# lm(mpg~poly(hp,2),data=mtcars)
fit_lm_quad=lm(mpg~hp+I(hp^2),data=mtcars)
summary(fit_lm_quad)
```

Residual Plot

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
mtcars2=mtcars |>
  mutate(yhat=predict(fit_lm_quad),
         res=mpg-yhat)
head(mtcars2[,c("mpg","yhat","res")])
```

```{r}
mtcars2 |>
  ggplot(aes(x=yhat,y=res))+
  geom_point()
```

Log-log plot

```{r}
mtcars |>
  ggplot(aes(x=hp,y=mpg))+
  geom_point()+
  scale_x_log10()+
  scale_y_log10()
```

```{r}
fit_lm_log=lm(log(mpg)~log(hp),data=mtcars)
```

```{r}
mtcars |>
  ggplot(aes(x=hp,y=mpg))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line(aes(y=exp(predict(fit_lm_log))))
```
